caseName: Twentieth Century Associates, Inc. v. Waldman
caseNameFull: Twentieth Century Associates, Inc. v. Waldman
attorneys: Mr. Benjamin Bernstein for appellant., Nathaniel L. Goldstein, Attorney General of New York, Orrin G. Judd, Solicitor General, and Saul A. Shames, Assistant Attorney General, filed a statement on behalf of the State of New York, as amicus curiae, with respect to jurisdiction.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for the reason that it was not properly allowed. Rule 36, 28 IT. S. C. § 868; Bartemeyer v. Iowa, 14 Wall. 26.

Mb. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
